objects.description: One container of work. It is opened, worked in, and accumulates what it has touched; it is not scoped to any one capability, which is the whole point of it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Whoever it belongs to, exactly as they authenticated. Every listing is filtered by this, which is why it is a column rather than something a caller remembers to ask for.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What it is called in the list.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: What this work is, in the owner's own words.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was started.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When anything in it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: owner
indexes.description: The list a person sees when they sign in.

objects.description: One thing a workbook has touched, remembered well enough to render a row for it after the thing itself is gone.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: workbook_id
fields.description: The workbook that touched it.

fields.name: module
fields.description: Which capability it belongs to, in that capability's own name.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Where it lives, as an opaque key this module compares and never interprets.

fields.name: item
fields.description: What it is, in the owning capability's own key.

fields.name: label
fields.description: What to call it in a listing, captured when it was touched so a row survives the thing being deleted.

fields.name: first_seen
fields.description: When this workbook first touched it.

fields.name: last_seen
fields.description: When it last did.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been dropped from the workbook.

indexes.name: workbook
indexes.description: Everything one workbook has touched, most recent first.

indexes.name: item
indexes.description: Which workbooks have touched one thing.

objects.description: One act performed in a workbook, named by the action its own declaration carries. This is what a shortcut is computed from, and what makes a workbook a record of work rather than a folder of bookmarks.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: workbook_id
fields.description: The workbook it was performed in.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The declared action performed, compared exactly and never interpreted.

fields.name: reference_id
fields.description: What it was performed on, when it was performed on something.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Who performed it. A shared workbook is used by more than one person.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When.

indexes.name: workbook_at
indexes.description: What happened in this workbook, most recent first.

indexes.name: workbook_action
indexes.description: How often one action has been performed here, which is what ranks a shortcut.

objects.description: An act worth offering again. Derived from the uses beside it and never authored: it appears because somebody did the thing here, which is what keeps the list honest and what stops a menu being maintained per capability.

fields.name: workbook_id
fields.description: The workbook it belongs to.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The declared action it offers.

fields.name: label
fields.description: What to call it in the sidebar.

fields.name: uses
fields.description: How many times it has been performed here.

fields.name: last_used
fields.description: When it last was, which is the other half of the ranking.

indexes.name: rank
indexes.description: The sidebar's own order: most recently used first.

objects.description: A key that opens one workbook for somebody who was sent it. Grants cover a person who already has an account here; this covers the one who does not, and is the shape mwanachama-backend-catalog's share_link already proved.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: workbook_id
fields.description: The workbook it opens.

fields.name: key_hash
fields.description: The key as stored. The key itself is shown once, at issue, and never again.

fields.name: label
fields.description: What this key was handed out for, so a rotation can say which one it replaced.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether it still opens the workbook.

fields.name: issued_by
fields.description: Who issued it.

fields.name: issued_at
fields.description: When.

fields.name: retired_at
fields.description: When it stopped working. A retired key is kept rather than deleted, so a rotation leaves a trail of what was handed out and when it stopped.

indexes.name: workbook_status
indexes.description: The keys live on one workbook.

objects.description: How a workbook is arranged: which regions it has, which blocks sit in them, and which declared actions those blocks are bound to. Stored whole or as a patch over another layout, and never read by this module: it keeps the document and its history, and the caller resolves it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: What it arranges, as an opaque key this module compares and never interprets: one workbook, one person's copy, or everything under one instance.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Whoever made it, exactly as they authenticated.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What it is called where layouts are listed.

fields.name: form
fields.description: Whether body is a whole layout or a merge patch over the layout named by base_id.

fields.name: base_id
fields.description: The layout a patch applies over. Empty for a whole one.

fields.name: base_version
fields.description: The version of the base this patch was last resolved against, so a newer base can be noticed and re-resolved.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Where it stands. Only a published layout can be the base of somebody else's patch.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Moves on every write, so a caller can refuse to overwrite one it has not seen.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The layout, or the patch. Action ids, parameter names and block ids only; the words on screen come from elsewhere at render time.

fields.name: set_aside
fields.description: Paths in a patch held back because the base now locks them. Kept rather than dropped, so they apply again if the lock is lifted.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was made.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: scope
indexes.description: The layouts one workbook, person or instance holds, most recently changed first.

indexes.name: base
indexes.description: Every patch over one layout, which is what a publish has to re-resolve.

objects.description: One change applied to a layout, kept with its inverse so it can be undone. A change arrives the same way whether a person dragged something, a model proposed it, or a sketch was read: as a patch somebody chose to apply.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: layout_id
fields.description: The layout it changed.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Who applied it. Proposing is not applying, so this is always a person.

fields.name: via
fields.description: How it was asked for, so a history can say so.

fields.name: patch
fields.description: What was applied.

fields.name: inverse
fields.description: What undoes it, computed when it was applied rather than when it is undone.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was applied.

fields.name: reverted_at
fields.description: When it was undone. An undone change is kept, so the history still says it happened.

indexes.name: layout_at
indexes.description: One layout's history, most recent first.

objects.description: Which layout one person sees in one workbook. Two people sharing a workbook can each work in their own arrangement of it.

fields.name: workbook_id
fields.description: The workbook.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The person.

fields.name: layout_id
fields.description: The layout they see there.

fields.name: chosen_at
fields.description: When they chose it.

indexes.name: layout
indexes.description: Who is looking at one layout, which is who a retirement or a publish affects.
